IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: synthetic-probe spike detected for /v1/generate (us-west-2) - 1854502468

Maria T.: anyone oncall? paging just hit me, looks like a burst of probe failures followed by a slew of low-rate 502s.

Ajay K.: oncall here, seeing the bot spam. Not seeing obvious infra OOMs in host logs. p95 latency for the route jumped.

Sam R.: quick check: model-serving pool reports a transient kv-cache stall, retries spiked. Could be kernel-level context switch, but might be probe flood amplifying a small GC/lock.

Priya L.: customer impact? any user-facing errors?

Ajay K.: quick metrics: error-rate for /v1/generate climbed from 0.02% -> 0.9% for ~6m. A handful of clients saw 502/503 retries. Overall RPS steady. (small number of customers saw degraded p95).

Maria T.: ok, immediate mitigation: can we throttle synthetic probes and mute the alert while we investigate?

Sam R.: I can patch probe config and create a temporary alert mute. Suggestions: increase probe interval, add a sliding-window threshold to avoid single-point flapping, and add a suppressed-alert when downstream fallback engages.

Ajay K.: +1. If probes are every 30s, they can create strong feedback loops. What's current probe config?

Sam R.: current probe snippet:```yaml
- name: synth-generate-usw2
  path: /v1/generate
  expected_status: 200
  interval: 30s
  timeout: 2s
  threshold: 1
```

Sam R.: proposed temporary change:```yaml
- name: synth-generate-usw2
  path: /v1/generate
  expected_status: 200
  interval: 180s   # back off probes during incident
  timeout: 3s
  threshold: 3     # sliding window: 3 fails in 5 attempts
  window: 5
```

Maria T.: will that hide a real outage? we need to ensure we don't blind ourselves.

Ajay K.: acceptable for now; we'll also add an explicit dashboard panel and a synthetic-only alert that uses a longer window so we retain visibility without paging.

Priya L.: I'll create the dashboard tile. Query: `sum by(region) (increase(synth_probe_failures[5m])) / sum by(region) (increase(synth_probe_total[5m]))` and show p95 latency overlay.

Sam R.: adding a mute on the pager for the synth-probe alert for the next 30 minutes while we roll the probe back. Doing a canary rollout of the new probe config now.

DeployBot: Started rollout of config `synth-probes/us-west-2` -> v2 at 1854502590. Rolling update 3/5 targets succeeded.

Ajay K.: after changing probe interval, we should also add a guard in alerting: require at least 2 distinct hosts to report failures before paging. That will stop single-host flaps.

Maria T.: agreed. Also set a rate limit on synthetic probes so they can't exceed X qps during recovery.

Sam R.: quick mitigation logs:```
[1854502489] synth probe fail -> backend 502
[1854502492] backend retry delayed, kv-cache lock contended
[1854502505] probe continues -> 3 fails in 90s
[1854502520] autoscale attempted, capacity added
[1854502535] backend p95 recovering -> 1200ms -> 220ms
```

Priya L.: Customer impact notes for postmortem: 6-minute window of elevated errors, affected ~0.12% of total requests, primary impacted customers: AcmeSuite and OptiSearch (both use long-running sync calls). No data loss reported.

Maria T.: ok create an incident ticket. I'll open INC-5567 with summary: "Transient synth-probe amplification -> backend latency spike (us-west-2)". Assign to Sam for root cause and Ajay for mitigation docs.

Sam R.: root-cause hypothesis: combination of aggressive probe frequency + a brief kv-cache mutex that increased latency -> retries -> more probes -> spike. Plan: make probe backoff default, add jitter to probe timings, and tune alert to use multi-host correlation.

Ajay K.: follow-ups: 1) PR to change default probe interval to 120s with jitter 0-30s (owner: Ajay). 2) Alert rule update to require failures from >=2 hosts in 10m window (owner: Maria). 3) Dashboard tile for synth-only metrics (owner: Priya). 4) Postmortem w/ customers (owner: Sam).

Priya L.: I'm taking oncall handoff in 5m; anything I need to monitor?

Maria T.: watch synth failure rate and the new dashboard panel. If it climbs again, escalate to Sam. I've unmuted the customer-facing alert; synth pager remains muted for 30m.

Ajay K.: leaving a note in ops-runbook: "synth probes should not exceed 1 qps per region for single endpoint. Use sliding-window thresholds and host-correlation. Add randomized jitter to avoid stampedes."

Sam R.: I'll also add a proactive regression alert that triggers when p95 increases >500ms AND synthetic-failure-rate>0.5% for 3m. That should reduce false positives and catch real regressions.

DeployBot: Rollout complete: 5/5 targets updated at 1854502675.

Priya L.: confirmed new probe interval applied. Observing synth failures drop to near-zero and p95 returning to baseline. Good.

Maria T.: thanks team. Actions captured in INC-5567. We'll schedule a short retro tomorrow to finalize probe defaults and dashboard queries.

Ajay K.: thumbs up :thumbsup:. If anything flares before Priya's handoff, ping me.

Priya L.: taking handoff now — oncall until 1854520000. Leaving Slack note in #escalations if anything else pops.

Maria T.: closing immediate thread. Postmortem to include timeline, probe config diffs, and customers notified list.

Sam R.: will draft the RCA and CRs tonight.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-5567 opened by Maria T. | severity: S2 | assignees: Sam R., Ajay K. | link: https://redwood/incident/INC-5567

Priya L.: thanks all, handing off.

Maria T.: thanks everyone :heart:
